description: Golden vector for Mmereko's outbound partner webhooks (docs/integrations/universityflow-partner-api.md section 12 item 6). Header x-mmereko-signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.mmereko.<body>")>. The body is the exact bytes sent (UTF-8, compact JSON, keys sorted). UniversityFlow's verifyWebhook(secret, 'mmereko', header, body, now) must accept it when now is within 5 minutes of timestamp. Synthetic values only.
